answer: A farm of 230 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in ocean, queued in pearl, and pulse publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 57 identities per epoch. A farm of 3945 identities would post 1367 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
